name: Torian Sha
description: A soul warden who once cursed the angels and now spends his gift of time in devotion to them.

description_citations.text: Magic 2010: card flavor text (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Torian Sha recalls cursing the angels until they rewarded his scorn with the gift of time, which he has spent in devotion.
timeline.quote: Until that day I cursed the angels, those uncaring lights in the sky.

citation.text: Angel's Mercy (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Torian Sha explains the law prohibits capital punishment so offenders can redeem themselves.

citation.text: Excommunicate (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
